name: Central European Free Trade Agreement (CEFTA)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the gold CEFTA emblem — a ring around the letter C with four bars and dots radiating from it.
history: The Central European Free Trade Agreement was signed at Kraków on 21 December 1992 by Czechoslovakia, Hungary and Poland; as the original members joined the European Union it became a Balkan and Moldovan grouping. The blue-and-gold colours were chosen because every member aspired to EU membership. No adoption date for the flag has been published.

features.symbolism: the members' aspiration to join the European Union
